label: integer-10000
_comment: The recorded input trace of GC-023's 10,000-step integer fixture: the shape, the seed and the schedules the player probe and the EditMode suite both drive. Nothing here is derived at load time; the generator turns it into the step script deterministically (IntegerFixtureGenerator.Generate). `observationDigest` is the digest of the scenario's named observation table. It is empty until the Linux build host records it from a passing `-probeReplay` run: tools/unity/run_replay_probe.sh compares against it only when it is non-empty, so an unrecorded digest can never pass as a recorded one. Record it by copying the `digest=` value from the `replay-digest` step of artifacts/gc-023/toolchain/probe-replay.json, then re-run the probe.
_hashes: Canonical state, decision, provenance, event and chain hashes are deliberately NOT literals here. The acceptance criterion TEST-022 states is that replays of the same recorded input agree with each other across worker counts and shuffled producer orders; a remembered hash would only assert that the code did not change, which is a weaker claim and a worse one to maintain. The probe and the suites compare two runs of this record, and the run's hashes are recorded in the probe artifact (artifacts/gc-023/toolchain/probe-replay.json) as the build host's measurement.
